[2] However, he does fall off as he sacrifices a lot of tankiness for damage and he can struggle into ranged champions top.

[2] Volibear's Q is an auto attack which grants him bonus movement speed which is doubled when moving towards an enemy champion. His next attack is empowered to have bonus range, deal bonus damage and stun the target.
[2] Then, if he uses this ability again on a marked target, it deals even more damage and massively heals him.

[2] Volibear's E places down a circle on the floor. Then, after 2 seconds, the area within is struck by lightning dealing damage to enemies within and slowing them. And if Volibear's within it, he gains a large shield.
[2] He also turns off enemy turrets in a nearby area also dealing damage to them which makes him insane at tower diving.
[2] However, he can struggle into ranged top laners who can kite him all game.

[2] After using your E and Q, your W has a 5-second cooldown. This means any fight that lasts longer than this 5 seconds, you get to use it twice. And when you use it twice, you get insane amounts of healing and damage out.
